name: ICJ Decisions & Orders

download.notes: The decisions listing page embeds direct .pdf links to judgments, orders and advisory opinions. Pattern: /sites/default/files/case-related/{caseNo}/{caseNo}-{YYYYMMDD}-{type}-{seq}-{sub}-{lang}.pdf where type is ord (order), jud (judgment) or adv (advisory opinion) and lang is en/fr/bi. Fetch the PDF URL directly.

enrich.notes: Case metadata (case number, date, document type, language) is encoded in the PDF filename itself; no separate item/record API is available.

methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The International Court of Justice publishes its judgments, orders and advisory opinions as PDF documents. The English entry point is https://www.icj-cij.org/en/decisions (which 302-redirects to https://www.icj-cij.org/decisions). The site is a classic server-rendered Drupal application, not a JavaScript SPA, so a plain HTTP GET returns fully-formed HTML containing real anchor tags to every decision PDF.

## Search
No dedicated search API or search-URL template was found for the decisions listing. The page offers only client-side category tabs (All decisions / Judgments / Orders / Advisory opinions). Discovery is therefore by browsing the listing rather than by keyword query.

## Filters
None exposed as URL parameters. Tabs filter by document type in the browser only. Case number, date, type and language are recoverable from each PDF filename after harvesting.

## Download
Direct PDF download. Links follow the stable pattern /sites/default/files/case-related/{caseNo}/{caseNo}-{YYYYMMDD}-{type}-{seq}-{sub}-{lang}.pdf (type codes: ord, jud, adv). No authentication or session is required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
No DSpace/record API. Structured metadata is parsed from the filename convention and surrounding HTML link text (case title, date). Enrichment mode is none.

## Limitations
Content is server-rendered so a headless browser is NOT required. There is no keyword search endpoint, so only browse-all + direct download are supported. The set link filter (.pdf) restricts harvesting to decision documents.
